mercury.conjunction: You think out loud in feelings, you cannot separate what you know from what you sense, and your memory for detail is unusually long.
mercury.harmonious: You can say how you feel while you are feeling it, which most people cannot, and it makes you easy to be near.
mercury.square: Your head and your gut file conflicting reports, and you talk yourself out of moods rather than through them.
mercury.opposition: You reason against your own feelings, and you rely on somebody else to tell you which of the two was right.

venus.conjunction: Comfort and affection are the same need for you, and you soothe yourself with food, beauty and being liked.
venus.harmonious: You are easy company: warm without effort, generous with reassurance, and genuinely restored by pleasant surroundings.
venus.square: What you need from people and what you want from them are different things, and you go looking for one and settle for the other.
venus.opposition: You need closeness and you need admiration, and the two have arrived from different people more often than from one.

mars.conjunction: Your feelings arrive as action; you are protective, quick to flare, and quite unable to brood quietly for long.
mars.harmonious: You defend the people you care about without hesitating, and doing something physical is how you clear a bad mood.
mars.square: Your temper is emotional rather than reasoned, it goes off before you have decided anything, and it is spent almost as quickly.
mars.opposition: Conflict lands on you personally and reaches you through other people, so somebody is always the aggressor in your account of it.

jupiter.conjunction: You feel things generously and at scale, you are hard to depress for long, and comfort is one of the things you overdo.
jupiter.harmonious: Your instinct is to expect the best of people, and you recover your spirits quickly enough that others come to you to do the same.
jupiter.square: Your moods are outsized, you overpromise emotionally, and you find you have committed to more than you can sustain.
jupiter.opposition: You look for reassurance in steadily larger doses, usually from somebody happy to supply it and not to be held to it.

saturn.conjunction: You learned early that needing things was inconvenient, so you manage without and describe that as being fine.
saturn.harmonious: Your emotional life has a structure to it, you are reliable in a crisis, and you do not come apart when it would be easiest to.
saturn.square: You are hard on yourself for feeling anything at all, and the loneliness that follows was very largely arranged by you.
saturn.opposition: Someone withheld warmth early and you keep re-encountering them, so you expect coldness and are startled into gratitude by ordinary kindness.

uranus.conjunction: Your moods are sudden and unpredictable even to you, and you need more room inside closeness than most people think to offer.
uranus.harmonious: You are emotionally independent without being cold, and you adapt to upheaval considerably faster than anyone expects.
uranus.square: You bolt when things get close, and the restlessness reads to other people as a lack of interest that it is not.
uranus.opposition: Your domestic life keeps being upended from outside, and you are drawn to people who cannot be relied upon.

neptune.conjunction: You absorb the mood of a room before anybody speaks, and you cannot always tell whose feeling you are currently having.
neptune.harmonious: Your sympathy is genuine and close to inexhaustible, and imagination is where you go to look after yourself.
neptune.square: You mistake your longing for your needs, and you look after other people partly so as not to examine your own.
neptune.opposition: You give more than you have and call it love, and it usually takes something going badly wrong before you see the pattern.

pluto.conjunction: You feel everything at maximum depth, you attach fiercely, and letting go of anything takes years rather than weeks.
pluto.harmonious: You are unfrightened by other people's darkest material, and you can sit with what cannot be fixed without needing to fix it.
pluto.square: Your needs come out as control, jealousy or silence, and the emotional crises of your life have all been the same crisis.
pluto.opposition: Intensity arrives through the people closest to you, and your relationships have a habit of demanding total honesty or ending.

ascendant.conjunction: You wear your mood on the outside; people read you across a room and there is nothing you can do about it.
ascendant.harmonious: The way you come across matches how you actually feel, which makes you unusually easy to trust.
ascendant.square: Your manner and your feelings contradict one another, so you are taken for cool when you are churning, or the reverse.
ascendant.opposition: Your emotional life is lived through other people, and you feel most like yourself when somebody else is in the room.

midheaven.conjunction: Your work has to feel right or you cannot do it, and your standing is bound up with how you look after people.
midheaven.harmonious: You can make a living out of what you naturally care about, and the public and private halves of your life feed each other.
midheaven.square: Your career and your home cannot both be fed, and every advance in one has been paid for out of the other.
midheaven.opposition: What you need and what you are meant to be seen doing point in opposite directions, and the family is usually where the bill lands.
